card.title: 41st BICYCLE REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 41st Bicycle Regiment of the Imperial Japanese Army was subordinate of the 9th Infantry Bicycle Brigade of the 5th Division. The division participated in the Second Sino-Japanese war and later in the war in the Pacific where it saw action in numerous battles and campaigns. In WWII the Imperial Japanese Army used bicycles extensively in their campaigns in Southeast Asia as they thought it was an efficient form of transportation and cheap for the war effort. Their bicycle soldiers could carry 36 kilograms of equipment and it often allowed them to move faster across terrain than the Allied forces.
